compiled:
📰 General

Zootopia 2 Shatters Disney Records, Becomes Studio’s Highest-Grossing Film •

Walt Disney Animation’s Zootopia 2 has achieved a remarkable milestone, surpassing $1.46 billion in global box office revenue. This accomplishment marks the film as the highest-grossing animated movie produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios. Despite this success, Pixar’s Inside Out 2 maintains the overall top spot for Disney with $1.698 billion in revenue. The film’s performance demonstrates strong audience interest in the Zootopia franchise.

🌍 World

Pope Leo Concludes Year with Hopeful Vision for a “New World” •

Pope Leo XIV concluded his year of service with a Vespers ceremony in St. Peter’s Basilica on December 31st, marking the First Vespers of the Solemnity of Mary, Mother of God. The event, attended by approximately 5,500 faithful, represented his final public celebration for 2025. Pope Leo expressed this occasion as a “powerful sign of a new world,” reflecting on the significance of the liturgical moment. The ceremony concluded the year with a message of hope and renewal within the Catholic community.

🦅 US

Canada Announces 2026 Olympic Hockey Roster: NHL Players Return to the Games •

Team Canada has released its roster for the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milano Cortina, marking the first time NHL players will compete in the Games since 2014. The team’s selection includes 23 players, all currently active in the National Hockey League. Notably, forwards Ryan McLeod and Cutter Gobeil are among the players with prior Olympic experience. The roster represents a significant return of professional hockey talent to the Olympic stage.

💰 Business

$400,000 Worth of Lobster Meat Stolen From Shipment Bound for Costco •

A shipment of $400,000 in lobster meat, destined for Costco stores in Illinois and Minnesota, was stolen in a series of incidents across New England. The theft involved approximately 40,000 oysters and a significant quantity of crabmeat, all part of the same shipment. Authorities are investigating a fraudulent trucking company suspected of being involved in the scheme. The stolen seafood represents a substantial financial loss for the distributors.

💻 Technology

Amazon Offers Significant Discounts on Popular Manga Box Sets Today •

Amazon is currently offering substantial discounts on a variety of manga box sets as of December 31st. The deals represent a shift in consumer interest towards physical media, following rising streaming service costs. Several popular manga series are included in the sales, with prices significantly reduced compared to standard retail. These offers are available for a limited time, encouraging immediate purchase decisions among collectors and fans.

🎭 Entertainment

Zendaya Dominates Met Gala, Showcasing Stunning Custom Valentino Gown •

Zendaya graced the 2024 Met Gala with a breathtaking custom Valentino Haute Couture gown designed by Pierpaolo Piccioli. The dress featured a dramatic, floor-length silhouette with intricate embellishments and a deep V-neckline. She accessorized with Tiffany & Co. jewelry and a stunning diamond bracelet. The event celebrated the theme "Sleeping Beauties: Reawakening Fashion," and Zendaya’s appearance was widely considered a highlight.

🏅 Sports

Michigan Wolverines Face Significant Injury Setback Ahead of Citrus Bowl vs. Texas •

Thirteen Michigan football players are ruled out for today’s Citrus Bowl matchup against the Texas Longhorns due to various injuries. Among those sidelined are key contributors like Jordan Marshall, Andrew Sprague, and Mason Curtis, impacting the Wolverines’ offensive and defensive lineups. These injuries were anticipated following head coach Biff Poggi’s remarks regarding the team’s condition yesterday. The extent of the injuries remains unclear, but their absence presents a significant challenge for Michigan’s chances in the bowl game.

🔬 Science

Ancient Spider Fossil Reveals Surprising Discovery: Spiders Once Possessed Tails •

Scientists have unearthed a remarkably preserved spider fossil encased in 100-million-year-old amber, significantly altering the understanding of spider evolution. The fossil exhibits spinnerets similar to those found in contemporary spiders, alongside a previously unknown elongated tail structure. Researchers believe this tail likely aided in climbing and maneuvering within their ancient environments. The discovery suggests a more complex evolutionary history for spiders than previously assumed, potentially indicating a lineage where tails were a common feature. Further research is planned to investigate the function and genetic basis of this unique anatomical trait.

🩺 Health

Dr. Oz’s Flu Shot Comments Spark Outrage Amid Rising Hospitalizations •

Recent data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) indicates a significant surge in influenza cases, with hospitalizations nearly doubling within the past week. This increase is attributed to a new influenza variant, referred to as the “super flu,” which is spreading rapidly. Experts are expressing concern over the rapid escalation of cases and the potential strain on healthcare systems. The CDC is continuing to monitor the situation and provide updated guidance on prevention and treatment.
